notes: Family architecture white paper (14 PDF pages), not a system card. No safety/alignment/refusal/jailbreak/bias/dangerous-capability tables or scores. Skipped all capability numbers (Arena-Hard-v2, AIME25, IFBench, τ2-Bench/2-Bench, SWE-Bench, LiveCodeBench/LCB v6, RULER, MMLU/MMLU-Pro, HumanEval/MBPP, GSM8K/MATH-500, ARC, WinoGrande, RACE, GPQA, SciCode, AALCR, and LatentMoE/MTP/NVFP4 ablations). Nano size appears only as model name Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B; Super/Ultra parameter counts are not stated here. Apache 2.0 applies to post-training software (NeMo-RL/NeMo-Gym), not named as a model license. Contributor group labeled Evaluation, Safety and Release is not a safety evaluation section. Figures 2, 5, 7, and 8 are mostly chart images with sparse recoverable numbers; none are safety evals.
